title.zh: 无颌鱼类来源限定证据

description.en: Open the Explorer at Agnatha to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开无颌鱼类，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

title.zh: 志留纪秀山鱼出现窗口

description.en: Open a source-bounded Xiushanosteus time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的志留纪秀山鱼时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

title.zh: 秀山鱼回星哨组关节连接标本窗口

description.en: Open the map at the rounded 436 Ma Huixingshao Formation window to inspect sampled context beside the articulated Xiushanosteus mirabilis holotype IVPP V300001 and referred bodies.
description.zh: 在约 4.36 亿年前的回星哨组时间窗口打开地图，结合秀山鱼模式标本 IVPP V300001 及归入标本的关节连接化石检查采样背景。

limitations: IVPP V300001 and IVPP V300002–V300021 are a bounded articulated specimen sample from the middle-to-late Telychian Huixingshao Formation, Xiushan County, Chongqing; 436 Ma is a rounded horizon selector, not a direct date for each body. Placoderm-grade and stem-gnathostome placement is constrained by the published phylogenetic model, not direct ancestry. The bounded sample and map markers do not establish a global FAD or LAD, complete distribution, behaviour, or exact specimen-marker co-registration.
IVPP V300001 与 IVPP V300002–V300021 是重庆秀山县回星哨组中—晚特列奇期的有限关节连接标本样本；4.36 亿年是取整后的地层选择值，并非每件标本的直接测年。盾皮鱼级与有颌类干群的位置受已发表系统发育模型约束，并不表示直接祖先。该有限样本和地图标记不确立全球首现或末现、完整分布、行为或标本与标记的精确空间共位。

title.zh: 原七鳃鳗维特普特组口盘标本窗口

description.en: Open the map at the rounded 359.5 Ma Famennian window to inspect sampled context for Priscomyzon riniensis holotype AM5750 from Waterloo Farm.
description.zh: 在取整为 3.595 亿年前的法门期窗口打开地图，检查南非滑铁卢农场原七鳃鳗模式标本 AM5750 的采样背景。

limitations: AM5750 is one 4.2 cm specimen from the Famennian Witpoort Formation at Waterloo Farm, Eastern Cape, South Africa; 359.5 Ma is a rounded study window, not a direct date on the fossil. Its total-group lamprey placement is a phylogenetic-model result, while feeding, migration and lifecycle are not preserved observations. This one-specimen sample and map markers do not establish a crown-Petromyzontida FAD, complete distribution, direct ancestry, behaviour, or exact fossil-map co-registration.
AM5750 是来自南非东开普省滑铁卢农场法门期维特普特组的一件 4.2 厘米标本；3.595 亿年是取整后的研究窗口，并非该化石的直接测年。其七鳃鳗总群位置来自系统发育模型；取食、洄游和生命周期均非保存下来的观察。单件样本和地图标记不确立七鳃鳗目冠群首现、完整分布、直接祖先、行为或化石与地图的精确共位。

title.zh: 盲鳗干群弗朗西斯溪页岩解剖镶嵌窗口

description.en: Open the map at the rounded 308.5 Ma Moscovian window to inspect sampled context for Myxinikela siroka holotype FMNH PF15373 and paratype FMNH PF8472.
description.zh: 在取整为 3.085 亿年前的莫斯科期窗口打开地图，检查盲鳗干群模式标本 FMNH PF15373 与副模式标本 FMNH PF8472 的采样背景。

limitations: FMNH PF15373 and FMNH PF8472 are a two-specimen sample from the Moscovian Francis Creek Shale at former Pit 11, Illinois; 308.5 Ma rounds the 310–307 Ma stratal envelope and is not a direct date on either fossil. Stem or putative total-group hagfish placement depends on the revised anatomical and phylogenetic model; modern habitat, slime production and ecology are not observed. The bounded sample and map markers do not establish a crown-Myxini origin, global FAD or LAD, complete distribution, direct ancestry, behaviour, or exact fossil-map co-registration.

FMNH PF15373 与 FMNH PF8472 是伊利诺伊州原 11 号矿坑莫斯科期弗朗西斯溪页岩的两件标本样本；3.085 亿年将 3.10–3.07 亿年的地层范围取整，并非任一化石的直接测年。盲鳗干群或推定总群位置依赖修订后的解剖与系统发育模型；现代栖息地、黏液产生和生态并非直接观察。有限样本和地图标记不确立盲鳗冠群起源、全球首现或末现、完整分布、直接祖先、行为或化石与地图的精确共位。

title.zh: 盲鳗纲哈朱拉冠群记录窗口

description.en: Open the map at the rounded 97.2 Ma Cenomanian window to inspect the source-bounded crown-Myxini context of Tethymyxine tapirostrum holotype BHI 6445.
description.zh: 在取整为 0.972 亿年前的森诺曼期窗口打开地图，检查嵌入盲鳗纲冠群语境的特提斯盲鳗模式标本 BHI 6445 的来源限定背景。

limitations: BHI 6445 is one complete Tethymyxine tapirostrum body fossil from the Cenomanian Hâdjoula Lagerstätte, Lebanon; 97.2 Ma is a rounded stage-scale selector rather than a direct specimen date. Crown-Myxini placement comes from the published morphology-based phylogenetic model, and the specimen is a sampling-dependent bound rather than an origin or behavioural observation. This single locality record and map markers do not establish a global FAD or LAD, complete distribution, direct ancestry, behaviour, or exact fossil-map co-registration.
BHI 6445 是黎巴嫩哈朱拉化石库中一件森诺曼期特提斯盲鳗完整身体化石；0.972 亿年是取整后的阶段尺度选择值，而非标本直接测年。盲鳗纲冠群位置来自已发表的形态系统发育模型，该标本只是受采样限制的界限，并非起源或行为观察。单一地点记录与地图标记不确立全球首现或末现、完整分布、直接祖先、行为或化石与地图的精确共位。

description.en: Compare Tujiaaspis and Xiushanosteus through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较志留纪土家鱼与志留纪秀山鱼；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.
